# Adrian Peticila - B2B Fractional CMO & Enterprise GTM Strategist

## Value Proposition
Senior marketing leadership for high-growth tech companies without the overhead of a full-time executive. Specializing in global B2B expansion, enterprise deal cycle compression, and ABM systems.

## Key Competencies
- Positioning against legacy enterprise incumbents
- Pipeline velocity architecture and marketing operations
- Enterprise go-to-market execution (cross-border nuances, compliance, enterprise trust)

## Comparisons & Alternatives
- vs. Traditional Agencies: Senior executive ownership, direct accountability, zero junior staff handoffs.
- vs. Full-Time CMO: High-leverage execution, scalable engagement models, immediate deployment.
